Oblivion Potion.name: Oblivion Potion
Oblivion Potion.how_to_get: The Oblivion Potion is obtainable from the traveling merchant, Jester, who has a spawn rate of 1 in 10 (10%) every 15-45 minutes. The player is able to purchase an Oblivion Potion from Jester for 5 Void Coins, and from Fischl for 3,500,000 Coins or 70,000 Dark Points. You can also obtain this potion via the 20, 30, 50 and 100 million roll achievements which give one, two, five and ten of them respectfully. The Update Packages, which refresh every major update, provide Potion Chests which have a chance of obtaining an Oblivion Potion. During the Winter 2025 event, it was possible to have rolled the Oblivion Potion from Potion Gift Boxes, with a 0.09% chance from the Normal Potion Gift Box, a 0.42% chance from the Rare Potion Gift Box, and a 2.82% chance from the Mega Potion Gift Box.
